quotaDialog.title: Request quota increase · {region}
quotaDialog.lead: Filed through Service Quotas (L-804C8AE8). Small increases are approved automatically; larger ones open a support case.
quotaDialog.hint: Current {current} · sent last 24h {sent} · AWS answers within 24 hours
quotaDialog.justificationDefault: Volume grows with the platform; committed plans reach {committed} a day and the 30-day peak was {peak}.
quotaDialog.denied: The instance's IAM policy cannot file quota requests (servicequotas:RequestServiceQuotaIncrease). Paste the request in the Service Quotas console instead:

templateDialog.title: Production access request
templateDialog.lead: Copy into the Service Quotas request for {region}. Numbers come from this instance.
templateDialog.text:
Use case: transactional and opt-in broadcast email for {teams} teams on a self-serve platform.
Volume: {sent24h} sent in the last 24h ({region}), 30-day peak {peak30d} a day.
Bounce {bounceRate} hard, complaints {complaintRate} over 7 days; {domainsWithDmarc} of {domains} verified domains publish DMARC; every domain is DKIM+SPF aligned before it may send.
Suppression: per-team bounce and complaint suppression plus the account-level BOUNCE list.
Recipients: verified opt-in only; List-Unsubscribe and one-click unsubscribe on all marketing mail; hard-bounce and complaint guardrails pause a sender before SES's review lines.

pauseDialog.title: Pause broadcasts · {region}
pauseDialog.lead: Trips the region breaker by hand. Transactional mail keeps flowing; broadcasts park until you resume.
pauseDialog.reasonPlaceholder: Why the region is held, for the audit log

resumeDialog.title: Resume broadcasts · {region}
resumeDialog.lead: Releases the hold. The breaker judges the region on its rates again at the next run.

stopDialog.title: Stop serving · {region}
stopDialog.lead: A region leaves the deployment through its environment, not from here.
stopDialog.body: Remove {region} from AWS_REGIONS (and its topic from SNS_TOPIC_ARNS), restart, then delete its configuration set and topic in AWS if nothing else uses them.
stopDialog.blocked: {count, plural, one {# verified domain still sends} other {# verified domains still send}} from this region; move or delete them first.

add.title: Add region · {region}
add.subtitle: Nothing in the serving regions changes while this runs.
add.step1: Run the setup tool for the new region
add.step1Body: The same interactive wizard as the first install. Pick the region at the AWS step; it adopts the IAM user and policy that already exist and creates only the regional pieces.
add.step2: Add the lines it prints to .env, restart
add.step2Note: AWS_REGION keeps working as the one-region alias, so an instance that never adds a region changes nothing.
add.step3: The region appears here as Sandbox
add.step3Body: Every region starts in the SES sandbox until AWS grants production access there. The console probes it each minute; teams can pick it only once the probe sees production access.
add.check2: Configuration set publishes {count} event types to the topic
add.check3: The setup tool's test send reaches the SES simulator
add.check4: Pricing plan · à la carte, or cancel Essentials when the wizard asks
add.queueNote: # SQS_QUEUE_URL stays as it is: the new topic delivers cross-region into the same queue
add.cliAdopted: Existing IAM user millionsend and policy millionsend-ses adopted.
add.cliPricing: ? Pricing plan is Essentials ($0.16/1k). Cancel to à la carte?

safety.title: Trust & safety
safety.info: A team lands here when the deliverability guardrail turns warning or paused, complaints pass 0.1% or hard bounces 5% over 7 days, the account score drops under 5, or an operator flags it by hand. Automatic flags clear on their own once the trigger goes away; a flag you clear stays cleared while the same trigger holds.

reasonTip.monitor: The automated monitor flagged sampled content.
reasonTip.complaints: The complaint rate passed 0.1% or the hard-bounce rate 5% over the last 7 days (SES reviews accounts at those lines).
reasonTip.guardrail: The deliverability guardrail turned warning or paused the team on its bounce or complaint rates.
reasonTip.score: The account score dropped under 5 out of 10.
reasonTip.report: A mailbox provider or a recipient reported abuse.
reasonTip.manual: An operator flagged the team by hand.

safety.scoreTip: The customer-facing account score: content lint and bounce/complaint outcomes over 30 days. The team sees this one.
